content.text:
* Complementary-input, two-stage OTA with Miller compensation
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* Bias: IBIAS is sourced externally at 10 uA
XBN IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 m=1
XBP1 PB IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 m=1
XBP2 PB PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=15 l=1 m=1
* Direct PMOS input pair covers low input voltage
XPT PS PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=30 l=1 m=1
XPP X VINP PS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 m=2
XPN PD VINN PS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 m=2
XPMD PD PD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=2 m=1
XPMO X PD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=2 m=1
* NMOS followers shift high inputs down to a second PMOS pair
XSFP VDD VINP SFP VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 m=8
XSFN VDD VINN SFN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 m=8
XSFC1 SFP IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=80 l=1 m=1
XSFC2 SFN IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=80 l=1 m=1
XHPT HS PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=30 l=1 m=1
XHPP X SFP HS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 m=4
XHPN PD SFN HS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 m=4
* Common-source output stage and series nulling resistance
XPO VOUT PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=90 l=1 m=1
XNO VOUT X VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=90 l=1 m=1
RZ X CM 6000
CC CM VOUT 2.8p
.ends DUT
